concerts.name: ROOF OVER HER HEAD
concerts.description:
A ROOF OVER HER HEAD. A FUTURE FOR HER CHILDREN.

Behind this charity concert is the story of a young mother and her two little sons, survivors of domestic violence, who are now left without a home or a support system to turn to. This December, Sisters-at-Law, with the generous support of Dr. Manella Joseph, invites you to be part of an evening of music, love and giving.

Join us for a special Sing-Along Musical Evening featuring Dr. Manella Joseph, a renowned singer and retired histopathologist attached to Sri Jayawardenepura General Hospital, as she performs her own original songs alongside much-loved old favourites. Come enjoy the music, sing along and be part of a meaningful cause! Every ticket purchased will contribute towards purchasing a piece of land on which a safe and permanent home can be built for this young mother and her children.

Your presence can help turn a story of hardship into one of hope, security and new beginnings.

📅 Date: 5th December 2026

🕡 Time: 6.30 PM Onwards

📍 Venue: Sri Lanka Medical Association Auditorium

🎟️ Ticket Price: Rs. 2,500/-

Come for the music. Sing for a cause. Help build a home. Organized by Sisters-at-Law, with the generous support of Dr. Manella Joseph.

concerts.description:
NEW YEAR'S EVE AT THE DOCTOR'S HOUSE The stars are aligning... ✨ The universe is getting ready for something big, and so are we.

This New Year's Eve, we're turning The Doctor's House into a sparkling universe of stars, zodiac signs and a little cosmic magic. Expect a grand finale to 2026 and an even more fabulous beginning to 2027.

Picture yourself walking into a starry night, with a little bit of the unexpected around every corner. Tarot cards predicting your future, a moon you actually can climb, sparkles following your steps and perhaps a few surprises written in the stars. We're bringing together a fantastic lineup of DJ artists to keep you dancing all the way into the new year. Young souls, old souls, dancing queens and occasional dancers - there's room for everyone on our dance floor.

The lineup will be revealed as we get closer, so keep your eyes on the stars (and our Instagram). Beyond the music, expect games, activities, beautiful decorations, delicious food, great drinks and enough fun to make you forget what planet you're on. Come dressed for the stars, bring your favourite people and leave whatever you don't want to carry into 2027 behind.

Last year we sold out completely, and tickets went FAST.

So if you want to start 2027 with us, make sure to secure your spot early! See you on the other side of midnight 🌙 31 DECEMBER 2026 The Doctor's House, Madiha, Sri Lanka

concerts.name: RUM JUNGLE
concerts.description:
Rum Jungle are coming to Sri Lanka — for the first time.

The Australian indie four-piece make their Sri Lankan debut at The Doctor's House on Saturday 9 January 2027, on their January Asia tour — and this is a night worth clearing your calendar for. They arrive off the back of second album Marginalia, which debuted at #2 on the ARIA Albums Chart, and a year of touring across Australia, North America, the UK and Europe.

Returning to Asia with new music and plenty of familiar favourites — after shows in Singapore, Bali and Tokyo — Rum Jungle are ready to reconnect with old fans and win over new ones. Raw alternative rock, jangling indie guitars and emotionally charged songwriting: music that sits somewhere between euphoria and uncertainty.

Add festival sets at Austin City Limits, Shaky Knees, Spilt Milk, Japan's CUEW Showcase and the Singapore F1 Grand Prix, and you have a band at the top of their rise.

One night. Sri Lanka's premier live music venue. First time, no second chances.

Tickets are on sale online now — book early, this will sell out fast.

concerts.description:
SOLA Festival is back for its third edition!

Set in the beachfront garden of The Doctor’s House, on the south coast of Sri Lanka, expect two days full of music, creativity and connection. Bringing together Sri Lankan and international DJs, artists, makers and people from around the world, SOLA is a celebration of music, culture and community.
